title: Little House on the Prairie
author: Laura Ingalls Wilder
summary: Laura Ingalls and her family leave Wisconsin in a covered wagon and settle on the Kansas prairie. Pa builds a house, and the family faces prairie fires, illness and tension with neighboring Osage people.
readIf: you like gentle pioneer stories full of everyday detail about building a home.
skipIf: you would be bothered by period attitudes toward Native Americans.
